output_list.code: function mintToken(uint256 _amount) { if (msg.sender == owner) { totalSupply += _amount; balances[owner] += _amount; Transfer(0, owner, _amount); } }
output_list.reason: The mintToken function allows anyone to mint new tokens, which can devalue the token in the market. The totalSupply is increased without any restrictions, which can lead to a situation where the token is more valuable than it should be.
